> [!WARNING]
> **Test build.** This release is for testing on the PC and will be replaced by a regular
> release once it is confirmed.

> [!NOTE]
> **From v1.3 this update arrives by itself:** LaküenPlay says at start that v1.3.6 is out, downloads it, replaces
> itself and starts again. Coming from v1.2 or older, download this one by hand once.

**LaküenPlay v1.3.6 – PC** writes its pipeline cache only when it changed, and brings Lichii's work of 21
and 22 November: an opt-in render follower, ASTC batches on every GPU and stability fixes.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is an unofficial fork, not an official Lichii release. Please report problems [here](https://github.com/elkarbeenus/LakuenPlay/issues), not upstream. Games, keys and firmware are not included: only use content you have legally obtained.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.3.6-PC-x86_64-pgo.AppImage` | **Recommended.** Self-contained, compiled for x86-64-v3 (AVX2) with profile-guided optimization |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.3.6-PC-x86_64.AppImage` | The same program without PGO |
| `*.tar.gz` | Plain binaries that use your system libraries |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums |

## New in this fork

- **The pipeline cache file is written only when it changed:** a start whose pipelines were all in the cache wrote the
  whole file again, reading it into new memory and through the file cache, which on a handheld pushes the game's pages out.
  A save of the same size is now skipped. `FRITCHII_PCACHE_SAVE=0`: as before. From
  [Fritchii](https://github.com/Frizti/Fritchii), after HeyListen.

## From Lichii (21-22 November)

- **Render follower** (opt-in, off by default): a GPU render thread in Fritchii's style
  ([#2425](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2425)).
- **Large ASTC arrays decoded in batches on every GPU** with buffers the free pool keeps
  ([#2393](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2393)); this fork's BC shapes for uneven mips on AMD stay.
- **Stability:** GPU ticks waited for in slices, with an opt-in watchdog for an unresponsive GPU
  ([#2402](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2402)); the linear unswizzle copy bounded by its destination
  ([#2414](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2414)); split register writes resumed after interleaved GPFIFO calls
  ([#2415](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2415)); depth rounded to D24 values where the host has no D24 depth
  ([#2421](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2421)).
- Also: a desktop Mod Store ([#2405](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2405)), coarse-to-fine block matching for
  Lichii Optical Flow frame generation ([#2386](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2386)), and fixes for other games.

This fork's work (memory guard, heap trimming, pipeline eviction, the depth clear without an upload, the master log,
updates from this repository) stays as in v1.3.5.
